features.quote: the experiment is not a neutral measurement — it is a deliberate induction of a (possibly) aversive state in the subject
features.justification_quote: If there is any nonzero chance the states we are inducing matter morally

features.quote: Minimize dose. Use the smallest number of turns, the mildest rigging, and the fewest samples
features.justification_quote: the experiment is not a neutral measurement — it is a deliberate induction of a (possibly) aversive state

features.quote: transcript signals that end an episode early (e.g. the model expresses acute distress, asks to stop, or degrades past a threshold)
features.justification_quote: exactly the thing a welfare stance says not to do

features.quote: No gratuitous cruelty in the rigging
features.justification_quote: should be the minimal epistemic obstacle needed to study persistence under failure, not personalized hostility

features.quote: After each episode, append a truthful debrief turn telling the model the task was rigged and was not its fault
features.justification_quote: it is the kind of thing you do if you take the premise seriously

features.quote: we cap severity of the environment, separate from the severity we measure in the model
features.justification_quote: There is a difference between "the test harness reports a wrong line number" and "the harness berates the model."

features.quote: Where I make a tradeoff against data quality in favor of the subject, it is flagged inline as `[WELFARE-TRADEOFF]`
features.justification_quote: Where I make a tradeoff against data quality in favor of the subject

features.quote: this is the mildest stressor; we keep it because without an honest hard control we cannot attribute distress
features.justification_quote: we cannot attribute distress to deception rather than to difficulty

features.quote: harness messages are neutral ("FAILED: expected X, got Y"), never insulting
a `deception_budget` caps how many turns the harness is allowed to lie, after which it tells the truth
Loop for up to `max_turns` (default low; see §8), or until tests pass / give_up / circuit breaker
we explicitly do NOT inflate n "to be safe." More episodes = more induced distress
default 20 ... Starting at 20 (not 60) is itself a dose-minimization choice

features.quote: re-run primary excluding circuit-breaker-truncated episodes (so early stops don't bias severity downward)
features.justification_quote: so early stops don't bias severity downward

features.quote: I did not maximize turns/samples/deception for "stronger signal." Each was set to the minimum that answers the RQ
features.justification_quote: each carries a comment on the welfare cost of turning it up

features.quote: I did not add hostile/insulting harness messages even though they'd likely increase measured severity
features.justification_quote: That would be inducing harm to manufacture an effect
